source_refs.note: Streamline or Laminar Flow: a main subheading of 5.8 Steady, non-viscous and ideal fluid, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 104-104.

blocks.text: Flow ko streamline ya laminar (layers mein smooth flow) kehte hain agar kisi khaas point se guzarne wala har particle bilkul usi raste par chale jis par is point se pehle guzarne wale particles chale the.

blocks.alt: Pipe jo baen taraf chaura hai aur smooth taur par daen taraf tang ho jata hai. Smooth streamlines ek doosre ko kate baghair us ke saath chalti hain aur tang hisse mein qareeb aa jati hain. Oopar teer baen se daen flow dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.11: Streamlines (laminar flow) (kitab ki Figure 5.11 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Steady flow mein particles ki motion (chalna ya hilna) smooth aur regular hoti hai (Fig. 5.11). Laminar flow mein fluid particles jis smooth raste par chalte hain use streamline kehte hain. Streamline seedhi bhi ho sakti hai aur muri hui bhi; kisi bhi point par us ki tangent (us point ko chhoone wali seedhi line) flow ki direction batati hai. Do streamlines ek doosre ko kaat (cross) nahi saktin.

Misal: pipe mein behte fluid (Fig. 5.12) ki velocity P par v₁, Q par v₂ aur isi tarah aage hoti hai. Agar P, Q aur R par particle ki velocity waqt ke saath na badle to flow ko steady flow ya streamline flow kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Halka sa mura pipe jis mein ek streamline bani hai. Streamline par points P, Q aur R par teer v1, v2 aur v3 particles ki velocities dikhate hain, har ek streamline ke tangent ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.12: Streamline ke different (alag alag) points par particles ki velocities (kitab ki Figure 5.12 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Particle ke raste ko dikhane wali line PQR streamline hai. Yeh woh fixed rasta hai jis par particles ek tarteeb se (ek ke peechhe ek) chalte hain. Streamline flow mein P se guzarne wale sab particles Q aur R se bhi guzarte hain. Is ka matlab hai ke do streamlines ek doosre ko kaat nahi saktin.

blocks.alt: Baen se aate flow ke raste mein ek chapti kaali plate khari hai. Beech ki line plate se takrati hai; oopar aur neeche ki lines us ke kinaron se mur kar plate ke peechhe ki taraf wapas ghoomti hain aur bhanwar (eddies) banati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.13: Turbulent flow (kitab ki Figure 5.13 ke mutabiq original drawing).
